objective:
Implement the council-approved standalone compact PWA navigation plan in the BB repository. You are the frontend construction lane. Work directly in the shared workspace, read and obey AGENTS.md, preserve existing untracked .context/ and .impeccable.md, use apply_patch for hand edits, and run repo-sanctioned Turbo checks. Do not invoke Model Relay or delegate further.

Product contract
- Behavior changes only when installed/standalone PWA AND compact viewport. Use display-mode: standalone plus safe iOS navigator.standalone fallback.
- Short horizontal swipe cycles previous/next pane in persisted workspace reading order.
- Long right swipe crossing about 68% opens the full-page Command Center: existing RootComposeView with blank prompt/agent controls and mobile Recent. It is not a pane/drawer and must never replace a pane.
- Velocity may complete a short tab swipe but can never promote to Command Center; long destination is distance-only.
- From a Command Center reached by swipe, left swipe returns with history pop/back, never pushes an alternating route entry.
- Sidebar opens only by explicit button in standalone compact mode. Disable the existing global right-swipe and wheel-to-open there only; retain Safari-tab/desktop behavior and drawer swipe-to-close.
- All page-specific chrome—header, toolbar, composer/footer, accessories—moves with and unmounts with its page. Exactly one interactive/a11y-visible owner after commit/cancel/interruption.
- All sidebar variants and all right secondary panel content/styles must coexist. Open/nested drawer blocks workspace gesture. Navigation closes open drawers while preserving selected panel tab/internal state.
- Preserve per-pane layout, focused pane, draft, and existing scroll-state facilities.
- Direct manipulation follows finger. New workspace settle token: 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). No transition:all in touched gesture/control code; transform/opacity only during drag. Reduced motion preserves behavior with quiet state/opacity feedback.
- Compact targets touched by this feature should be >=44px, press scale exactly 0.96 where appropriate, no overlapping hit areas.

Council-resolved technical decisions
1. Add a single tested standalone-compact capability helper. Every change consumes it.
2. Guard route reconciliation at its boundary. Gesture preview does not change URL. Successful long-swipe commits navigate to "/" with a validated standalone compact Command Center intent. That intent skips reconcileLayoutForContent so existing split layout/focused pane survives. Direct/non-standalone "/" behavior remains policy-compatible; add a negative regression test.
3. Compact pane traversal must extract/use getAdjacentPaneId/listPanes directly; existing pane.focus handlers are split-active gated and cannot be reused as handlers.
4. Add a compact PWA page transition host wrapping complete destination surfaces. AppLayout must not leave independent route chrome over any surface; handle plugin panels explicitly if they participate. Outside capability retain current ownership.
5. Pointermove must never synchronously mount a full ThreadDetailView. Use a lightweight inert preview/shell from PaneContent metadata; no autofocus, secondary panel, terminal/plugin activation, duplicated subscription, or new fetch. Mount full target only after commit while keeping visuals stable.
6. RootCompose preview must be inert and must not autofocus or open secondary content. If sharing RootCompose internals safely is too invasive, render a faithful lightweight Command Center preview and mount the real RootComposeView only after route commit.
7. Close transient menus/popovers/drawers and release pointer capture on navigation. Cancel fully restores source.
8. Exact history: successful Command Center commit pushes one "/" entry containing return metadata; left-swipe return calls navigate(-1)/history.back when valid. Direct launch "/" has no return target.
9. Keep server/daemon protocol untouched.

Implementation sequence
A. capability + validated navigation state/policy + tests;
B. compact pane traversal/non-destructive focus;
C. compact standalone chrome ownership;
D. sidebar gesture gating + workspace gesture coordinator;
E. lightweight preview/transition host/chrome lifecycle;
F. Command Center route/history round trip;
G. panel arbitration and compact sheet sizing where safely inferable;
H. visible workspace position/switcher if feasible without broad new product surface, plus touch/a11y/loading polish;
I. focused tests, Turbo typecheck/test, and diff self-review.

Gesture details
- Horizontal intent ~12px and horizontal dominance before capture/preventDefault.
- Ignore inputs, textarea, select, contenteditable, sliders, expanded text selection, horizontally scrollable regions, sidebar/panel triggers, Vaul/Radix drawers/dialogs, and explicit data opt-out.
- Short distance threshold ~33%; short fling threshold may reuse current ~12% + 450px/s.
- Long Command Center threshold ~68% physical width only.
- Use pointer capture; handle pointercancel, lost capture, resize/orientation/unmount deterministically.
- Boundaries resist and cancel. Never steal Safari browser-edge behavior outside standalone mode.
- Include a polite live-region tab announcement and reduced-motion branch.

Required verification
- Tests: standalone capability true/false; negative non-standalone route reconcile; long Command Center preserves 1–8 panes/focus; back pops; fast short fling cannot open Command Center; sidebar PWA swipe/wheel disabled while browser compact behavior remains; excluded gesture targets; cancel/interruption; no duplicate active chrome; panel-open arbitration if testable.
- Run targeted tests with Turbo per AGENTS.md, then pnpm exec turbo run typecheck --filter=@bb/app. Run app lint if changes pass typecheck. Pipe slow test output to /tmp and inspect it.
- Report exact files changed, checks and results, remaining limitations, and any acceptance item deliberately deferred. Do not claim real-device 60fps without testing it.
acceptance_checks: New navigation behavior is strictly standalone-compact gated and non-standalone behavior has negative regression coverage.
Short swipe focuses adjacent persisted workspace pane; long-right distance-only gesture opens Command Center without replacing or inserting a pane.
Left swipe from gesture-opened Command Center pops history and returns to the preserved workspace.
Standalone compact sidebar no longer opens through workspace swipe or wheel; button and drawer close gesture remain.
Outgoing complete page chrome transitions together and no duplicate interactive/a11y chrome remains after settlement or cancellation.
Gesture target exclusions, interruption handling, reduced motion, and live announcements are implemented and tested proportionally.
All changed code passes targeted tests and @bb/app Turbo typecheck, or exact blockers are reported with evidence.
No server/daemon wire contract is changed and unrelated/untracked user files are preserved.
